cases.sentence: Когда Аталия увидела, что ее ___ мертв.
cases.translation: When Athaliah saw that her son was dead.
cases.explain: The noun stands as the subject complement of мертв.

cases.translation: Jehosheba, the woman from the palace.
cases.explain: The noun stands in nominative as identification.

cases.translation: She hid him in the bedroom.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location meaning governs the prepositional case.

cases.translation: In the seventh year of Athaliah's reign.
cases.explain: The preposition на (in) with temporal meaning governs the dative case.

cases.translation: Each with a weapon in hand.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.
The transitive verb возложил (put on) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Услышав шум стражи и ___, Аталия отправилась к ним.
cases.translation: Hearing the noise of the guard and the people, Athaliah went to them.
cases.explain: In the conjunction after шум, the genitive case is used.

cases.translation: All the people blew the trumpets.
cases.explain: Transitive verb трубил with в takes accusative.
